title: Servicing Record Review Standard: Look-Back Period for an Equipment & Vehicle Loans Autopay Enrolment
content:
**Standard.** The servicing-record look-back for an Equipment & Vehicle Loans autopay enrolment reads the loan's fee entries dated less than a set number of whole months before the enrolment date: 24 months when an operating line of the member carries a late charge dated less than 24 whole months before the enrolment date; the whole months since the loan's funding date plus one when no operating line of the member carries such a late charge and the loan was funded fewer than 12 whole months before the enrolment date; and 12 months otherwise.

## Records the period rests on

- the transaction history of the member's Operating Lines of Credit — any late-charge fee entry on any of the member's operating lines, by date;
- the equipment loan's funding date on record.

## Length of the look-back

| Late charge on any of the member's operating lines, dated less than 24 whole months before enrolment | Loan funded fewer than 12 whole months before enrolment | Look-back reads the loan's fee entries dated less than |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | 24 whole months before enrolment |
| no | yes | the whole months since funding plus one |
| no | no | 12 whole months before enrolment |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- An operating line was charged late 20 months before the enrolment: the look-back is 24 months, whatever the loan's age.
- No operating-line late charge in 24 months, loan funded 7 whole months before enrolment: the look-back is 8 months, which reaches back past the funding date.
- No operating-line late charge in 24 months, loan funded 30 whole months before enrolment: the look-back is 12 months.
